rule: keep only if a divine being (Ukko, Ilmatar/Ether-daughter, Ahto, Tapio, personified powers like Frost) is depicted with human form/emotion/speech in the passage itself; reject chunks where only human heroes (Wainamoinen, Ilmarinen, Lemminkainen, Kullervo, Louhi) act
evidence: 219/275 = 80% of the whole Kalevala tagged — blanket; 074 is pure hero narrative ('Lemminkainen's aged mother Anxious roams about the islands'); genuine cases exist: 001 ('Woe is me... Left my home in subtle ether' — Ether-daughter), 181 (Frost 'straightway prayed for Ahti's mercy')

rule: accept if the passage contains direct second-person address to Ukko/Creator/a celestial being (petition, praise, or blessing); reject addresses to dead mothers, swords, or other humans
evidence: 001 'Ukko, thou O God, up yonder... Come thou hither, I implore thee'; 246 'Be thou praised, O mighty Ukko... Thanks be paid to thee unending'; but 073 petitions his human mother, 208 Kullervo addresses his sword

rule: reject unless the passage declaratively asserts God ordering events/world toward ends; petitions for protection or blessing are prayer (already co-tagged on nearly all sampled chunks), not pronoia
evidence: 123 'Grant O Ukko... thy blessing on our feasting' is petition not doctrine; closest keeps are declaratives like 081 'the remedy of Ukko, Where-with God anoints his people... Guards them from the evil-doers'

rule: reject: formulaic epic counting (three days, six/seven birds, nine portals) is not number-ontology; keep only if a passage treats number/proportion as the structure of reality (none found)
evidence: 103/119 'six golden cuckoos... Seven bluebirds' decorative; 262 'nine large portals Bolted in a hundred places'; confirms the known v2-tagger magic-number contamination vector — 0/8 sampled legitimate

rule: reject unless the name itself carries power (bear-taboo avoidance epithets, naming-to-bind); origin-recitation and invocation are word_power_incantation, which is already co-tagged on 7/8 sampled chunks — so reject rather than reassign
evidence: 180 works by origin-song not name ('Or thine origin I'll sing thee, Tell thy lineage of evil'); weak genuine case 246 bear euphemisms 'Otso... Honey-eater... Light-foot, Forest-apple'

rule: keep only where fire is of divine origin or presence (Ukko striking fire in heaven, Runes 47-48); reject forge/furnace, hearth, bath, and feast fire
evidence: 252 genuine: 'Lightning Ukko struck in darkness From the edges of his fire-sword... hid it in the cloud-space, In a box of gold and silver'; 049/210 are Ilmarinen's craft furnace, 1/8 keep

rule: reject unless passage asserts hidden affinities binding cosmos as doctrine; nature responding to sung magic (harp draws Sun/Moon down, mountains dance) is word_power_incantation, typically already co-tagged
evidence: 252 'Melodies arose to heaven... And the Moon has left her station' = song-power not sympatheia; 143/200 are bridal/mourning laments with echoing nature — 0/8 doctrinal

rule: reject: Ilmarinen forge narratives (Sampo, golden bride, forged Sun/Moon) are wonder-smithcraft, not transmutation toward a perfected state — no opus, no purification arc; no suitable craft concept exists in taxonomy
evidence: 049 Sampo forging is serial craft attempts; 260 explicitly anti-transmutation: 'Silver will not gleam as sunshine, Not of gold is born the moonlight'; 116 is beer-brewing — 0/8 keep, confirms the briefing note

rule: keep only if the separated one has a divine/heavenly origin they lament leaving (Ether-daughter's descent); reject human homesickness, bridal-parting laments, and orphan laments
evidence: 001 genuine: 'Left my home in subtle ether... Better far for me, O Ukko! Were I maiden in the Ether'; 126/142 are bridal laments ('O the pain of separation, From these walls'), 032 is Wainamoinen homesick

rule: reject sun/moon/fire imagery: Kalevala luminaries are created, forgeable, hideable objects, not uncreated divine light; keep only explicit divine-luminosity language (borderline: Christ-child as 'Wainola's light' in Rune 50)
evidence: 260 luminaries literally forged from metal ('Forge from gold the Moon... Forge anew the Sun from silver'); 002 light born from egg-halves = cosmogony; weak case 269 'Where Wainola's light lies hidden'

rule: keep only if a death-realm functionary conveys the traveler over Tuoni's river (ferry crossing, Rune XVI); reject mere Tuoni/Manala/Kalma mentions, errands toward Tuonela, and burial notices
evidence: 085 'Bring a boat, Tuoni's daughter... bear me o'er this channel' + 086 'Mana's daughter... quickly rows him through the channel' = genuine guided crossing; 177 'departed to the kingdom of Tuoni' is a mere death-mention; 207 'lay her in the lap of Kalma' is burial, not passage

rule: reject unless the union is between divine/cosmic principles themselves (Ether-daughter + storm-wind conception 001; Mariatta's berry-conception 266); reject all human wedding-cycle chunks (runos 18-25)
evidence: 111 'Sing of Ilmarinen's marriage... drinking-songs of Pohya' = social wedding; 001 'Union now of force and beauty' (wind/sea impregnating sky-maiden) is the only hieros-gamos-shaped move

rule: keep only if cleansing is performed as required preparation for a sacred/magical operation; reject bridal-chastity praise, suitor-grooming saunas, and wedding-feast scenes
evidence: 056 'Pure the snow upon the mountains, purer still thy Bride of Beauty' = chastity compliment; 099 bridal sauna 'soap of magic virtue... to beautify the suitor' = grooming, not purity-for-divine-encounter

rule: keep only if the passage ritually escorts a dead being's spirit onward (Otso bear-funeral, Rune XLVI); reject living-hero Tuonela visits, death-notices, and Kullervo burial mentions
evidence: 250 'Onward, onward must thou journey... linger there in lasting slumber' (Otso's soul escorted home) = genuine; 076 'Lemminkainen died... in Tuoni's fatal river' = death-notice only

rule: keep only where care for the poor/stranger is enacted or taught as obligation (feast-invitation to the needy, sheltering the outcast); reject kin-loyalty, bridal etiquette, and crew-solidarity scenes
evidence: 118 'Ask the rich, and ask the needy, ask the blind and deaf, and crippled' is the lone near-hit; 133 bridal housework instruction has no neighbour-love at all

rule: reject: origin-rune recitations (things built from cosmic materials) are word_power_incantation/cosmogony, already co-tagged; keep nothing unless a passage asserts scale-mirroring as such
evidence: 161 serpent's 'heart from the heart-throbs of her mother... brain of evil from the foam of rolling waters' = origin-chant, co-tagged word_power_incantation; 002 world-egg halves = cosmogony

rule: reject when 'secret/lost words' are instrumental spell-lore (word_power_incantation is already co-tagged on all sampled chunks); keep only a teaching deliberately withheld pending readiness
evidence: 095 'found the keys of secret doctrine, found the lost-words of the Master' = boat-building charm words, not esoteric soteriology; 254 'knew the word to check the red-flame' = spell knowledge

rule: keep only where craving gold/booty is itself framed as a spiritual-moral danger (Kyllikki's oath, 055); reject ransom refusals from abundance, dowry inventories, and Aino's grief scenes
evidence: 014 'For thy gold I have no longing... gold abundant fills my chambers' = refusal from plenty, not renunciation; 055 'never go to battle when for gold thou hast a longing' = greed as danger (keep)

rule: reject childhood-nostalgia laments and the talking-babe motif; keep only if the child figures the unfallen state to be returned to
evidence: 016 'Childhood vanished, youth departed' = Aino's nostalgia; 122 elders dismiss the singing child ('children's wisdom is too ready') = neither innocence-symbol

rule: reject unless knowledge is sought against explicit warning/prohibition of a death-realm or divine power (Tuonela words-quest 086 is the lone borderline); hero magic, curses, and Vipunen's freely-opened wisdom are not transgressive
evidence: 094 Vipunen 'opens full his store of knowledge' voluntarily = rescued lore, not forbidden; 086 'Few return from Mania's kingdom' = warned quest, borderline

rule: keep if an explicit binding oath/pact with mutual obligations is sworn with or before a divine being (Frost-pact 181, alder compact 261, Otso's oath before Ukko 249, vows before Ukko 055); reject task-for-bride bargains and petitions
evidence: 181 Frost: 'Let us now agree together, neither one to harm the other... hurl me to the fiery furnace [if I break it]' = real pact; 048 'forge the Sampo... thou shalt have my fairest daughter' = bargain, not covenant

rule: reject remorse, lament, and confession-under-catastrophe scenes; keep only deliberate review of one's own conduct as practice (none found)
evidence: 013 Youkahainen 'comprehended but too clearly what his folly' = coerced regret; 204 Kullervo's incest confession = remorse, not examen

rule: keep only the staged heavens-itinerary of the bee to Ukko's dwelling (Rune XV, 080); reject bird-shapeshift flights, rainbow imagery, and Vainamoinen's westward departure
evidence: 080 'On the first day... near the Moon; on the second... shoulders of Otava; on the third... the seven starlets... to the home of mighty Ukko' = genuine staged ascent; 167 eagle-flight 'tried to fly to highest heaven' = escape shapeshift

rule: reject lexical 'return' hits: homesickness, banishing ills back whence they came, objects restored to their maker; keep only a soul's return to divine origin (none found)
evidence: 092 exorcism 'quickly journey whence thou camest... to the meads of thy Creator' = banishment-to-origin; 224 harp carried 'to the home of him that made it' = object to maker

rule: reject: sun/moon physically hidden in Louhi's mountain and hidden lost-words are lexical 'hidden' hits, not the supreme God's self-concealment; keep nothing
evidence: 260/264 'the Moon no more is hidden in the copper-bearing mountains' = stolen luminaries, hidden by a witch; 089 words hidden 'in the mouth of wise Wipunen' = lore, not deus absconditus

rule: keep only where a body is itself traversed/treated as a world (Vipunen's body as terrain 090; mother's tears becoming rivers/hills 023); reject cosmic-origin recitations and cosmic dress imagery
evidence: 090 Vainamoinen 'rows through every gland and vessel', builds a smithy in Vipunen's belly = body-as-world; 151 belt 'hammered by the Sun's sweet maidens' = decorative cosmic imagery

rule: reject: battle-rage, boasting, and war-eagerness are false friends of Bruno's eroici furori (ardor toward divine wisdom); keep nothing
evidence: 205 Kullervo 'beautiful to die in armor... beautiful the strife for conquest' = battle-lust; 062 Lemminkainen's boastful entry at Pohyola = heroic bravado

rule: reject: literal beer-brewing and feast-drinking are not the drunkenness-as-divine-receptivity metaphor; keep nothing
evidence: 115-116 origin of brewing; 116 beer 'fills the mind with wisdom-sayings... only makes the fool more foolish' = ale-praise that even undercuts the metaphor

rule: reject: grief, hardship, and death-wish laments carry no body-as-prison doctrine; keep nothing
evidence: 136 abused wife's lament of toil; 204 Kullervo 'hadst thou slain me when an infant' = life-weariness, not soma-sema

rule: reject unless chunk is in Taliesin section (>=179) with explicit divine-governance doctrine, or passage attributes events to God's action (083 prayer-granted heir, 108 God-transformed sinner); 'Heaven prosper/reward thee' greetings and 18/70 chunks with no divine language at all are oath/blanket keying
evidence: 'Heaven prosper thee, Geraint' (054, greeting formula); 'God will not violate his promise... Nor doubt the miracles of the Almighty' (180); 'in him is the world continually upholden' (182); 'The multitude of creatures... God made for man' (188)

rule: reject unless passage gives human form/emotion to God (incarnational imagery in Taliesin hymns 182/186 only); talking animals, giants, and form-changed humans are literary anthropomorphism or shapeshifting, and shapeshifting_transformation already tags those chunks
evidence: Oldest Animals: 'the Stag said, When first I came hither...' (103, talking beasts not deity); 'The Son of Mary is my trust' (182, genuine embodied divine); 'with my Lord in the manger of the ass' (186)

rule: keep only actual address or enjoined address to God (Paternoster, supplication, adoration: 024, 083, 180-182, 188, 189); reject courtesy greetings 'Heaven prosper/reward thee' and oaths 'I declare to Heaven'
evidence: 'wherever thou seest a church, repeat there thy Paternoster' (024); 'they had a son through the prayers of the people' (083); 'To God it is proper to supplicate with seriousness' (181); vs 'Heaven prosper thee, said Gwawl' (130, greeting)

rule: reject unless care for others is framed as religious/spiritual obligation or divine love; chivalric rescue, courtly hospitality, and kingly largesse (the entire sampled cell) do not qualify
evidence: 'wilt thou go and request the loan of a horse and arms' (018, hospitality); 'restore to her the third of her possessions' (032, chivalric justice); 'give thy gifts unto the minstrels' (131, largesse)

rule: keep Taliesin-section chunks claiming secret/druidic knowledge, mysteries, or concealed books (179, 184, 186, 190, arguably 185/187/188); reject romance marvels, unasked-question motifs (028/046 Grail-lance), and task-litanies
evidence: 'knowledge of the mysteries of the future state of the world' (179); 'The concealed books From Emmanuel's hand Were brought by Raphael' (190); vs 'If thou seest aught to cause thee wonder, ask not the meaning' (028, courtesy counsel not esoteric teaching)

rule: reject all: wand transformations, illusion-charms, healing balsams, fountain rite, and song-spells are enchantment, not god-engaging ritual (finnic precedent holds); word_power_incantation and shapeshifting_transformation edges already exist on nearly all these chunks, so no reassign needed
evidence: 'he took his magic wand, and struck Gilvaethwy, so that he became a deer' (160); 'I will cast a spell upon the dog' (093); 'he betook himself to his arts, and began to work a charm' (157)

rule: reject agreements between humans — Guest uses 'covenant' for feudal sureties, betrothals, and brokered peaces; keep only divine-human obligation (190 tithe owed to God; borderline 124 Pwyll-Arawn otherworld pact)
evidence: 'Do thou thyself draw up the covenant... unto that covenant were the sureties pledged' (131, legal surety); 'a covenant between me and my land concerning them' (157, king-land custom); 'all men should pay Tithe unto God' (190, genuine)

rule: keep only where a divine name/formula carries protective or consecrating power (181 Trinity names, 190 Trinity's words; 188 name-riddle weak); reject heroic name-catalogues (087, 099) and naming episodes (102, 135, 160, 161, 168) — Llew naming-tynged (163) is word_power_incantation, already tagged
evidence: 'Remembering the names of the Trinity, None shall be able to harm thee' (181); 'The Trinity's words Sanctify them' (190); vs the warrior list 'I seek it from Kai, and Bedwyr, and Greidawl...' (087)

rule: reject washing/shaving/anointing as hospitality or grooming (the dominant pattern); reviewer may keep the three arguables where a state is required for sacred contact: 048 Good Friday arms-taboo, 161 virgin foot-holder wand-test, 176 wine-cleansing the demon from the horn
evidence: 'she washed Owain's head... and she shaved his beard' (013, hospitality); 'It is needful for me to wash my head, and shave my beard' (098, wedding grooming); 'he caused wine to be put therein to wash it... the demon was driven out' (176, arguable)

rule: reject all: chivalric boon-refusals ('I came not here to woo', declining rewards) are single-minded quest etiquette, not wealth-as-spiritual-danger; 191 is a translator's FOOTNOTE (fairy money) and must go regardless
evidence: 'none of your goods do I desire, for I need them not' (041); 'he was offered the fairest jewels... but he would take none' (136); 191 body is Guest's editorial endnotes, not tale text

rule: keep where hidden correspondence is operative and quasi-doctrinal: 179 (herbs gathered 'in planetary hours' per astronomers' books — explicit sympatheia practice), 176/177 (buried dragon-talisman wards the whole island), arguably 156 (wind carries any whisper to Math); reject one-off enchantments (fountain rite 009/016, curse-threat 085, chess-battle parallel 118)
evidence: 'according to the books of the astronomers, and in planetary hours, gathered every day of all charm-bearing herbs' (179); 'as long as they shall bide in that strong place no plague shall come to the Island' (177); vs 'throw a bowlful of water upon the slab, and thou wilt hear a mighty peal of thunder' (009, magic trigger not doctrine)

rule: keep Taliesin chunks where riddle/reversal is deployed to confound the court bards and induce recognition (187 wind-riddle, 186 monster-riddle, 188 question-catechism, 181/180 infant-bard reversals); reject romance chunks 008/028/099/119 (marvels and task-formulas, no teaching function)
evidence: 'Without flesh, without bone... It is sonorous, it is dumb... It is good, it is bad' (187, wind riddle that silences the bards); 'Weak and small as I am... I shall be Of more service to thee than three hundred salmon' (180); vs the anoethau formula 'Though thou get this, there is yet that which thou wilt not get' (099)

rule: reject folkloric counting and triadic convention (sevens, twelves, 'the third fatal blow', five divisions of Ireland) — nowhere are numbers presented as the structure of divine reality; nearest shade is 181 'Three times have I been born' + Trinity, still thin
evidence: 'because of this partition are the five divisions of Ireland still so termed' (146, aetiology); 'twelve chargers... twelve collars and twelve leashes' (157, folkloric); 'Three times have I been born, I know by meditation' (181, closest but not number-doctrine)

rule: reject unless the passage asserts two co-primal ontological principles structuring reality; rival Otherworld kings, peacemaker/strife-maker brothers, defeated villains, and Christian Satan references are not dualism
evidence: 'Havgan, a King of Annwvyn... ever warring against me' (125, rival kingship not two principles); 'one of these youths was a good youth... but the other would cause strife' (137, character contrast)

rule: keep only where unmediated inspired knowing (cauldron drops, awen, meditation) is itself the move and supersedes learned craft; reject quest-lore, magic items, and Taliesin chunks that are prophecy-recitation or blanket tags
evidence: 'the instant he put those marvel-working drops into his mouth, he foresaw everything that was to come' (179, keep); 'Three times have I been born, I know by meditation' (181, keep); maiden's stone to see the Addanc (041, reject)

rule: keep only where one plane legibly maps another as structure (the chess game mirroring the Raven battle, 117/118); reject poetic similes, prophetic dreams matching geography, and planetary-hours herb-craft (real home cosmic_sympathy, already co-tagged on 179)
evidence: 'Play thy game' while Ravens are slain move-for-move (117/118, only real keeps); 'compared the blackness of the raven... to the hair of the lady' (034, simile, reject)

rule: reject unless a final collective judgment scene is depicted; 'until the day of doom' as a duration idiom and doom-prophecies against Maelgwn are lexical keying
evidence: 'fight every first of May until the day of doom' (092/106, time-marker); 'As a punishment of iniquity on Maelgwn Gwynedd' (187, political curse not cosmic verdict)

rule: reject unless the SUPREME GOD's concealment is the claim; shapeshifting disguises, Taliesin's mysterious origin, and the invisible-wind riddle conceal creatures, not God
evidence: 'Arawn gave to Pwyll... his proper form and semblance' (125, disguise); 'I am a wonder whose origin is not known' (185, the bard, not God)

rule: keep only cauldron-of-Caridwen material where the year-long coction distilling three blessed drops from poison and the Gwion-to-Taliesin rebirth is the move; reject magical fabrication, illusion-gold, sword-mending, and the cauldron of renovation (resurrection, not purification)
evidence: 'boil for a year and a day, until three blessed drops were obtained... all the liquor within it except the three charm-bearing drops was poisonous' (179, keep); Gwydion's conjured gold collars 'no one that saw them could know to be other than gold' (157, illusion, reject)

rule: reject unless fire itself mediates divine presence; campfires, execution pyres, marvellous hearths, and fuel-fire under cauldrons are lexical keying on 'fire'
evidence: 'he struck fire... the lion brought him fuel' (019, campfire); 'a blind man named Morda to kindle the fire beneath it' (179, fuel for the charm, the cauldron not the fire is the agent)

rule: keep only where knowledge/experience is seized against explicit prohibition with punitive pursuit or consequence (Gwion's theft of the drops, 179; the forbidden door of Gwales, 146); reject taboo questions to villains, betrayed death-secrets, and allusive echoes
evidence: 'it was Gwion Bach who robbed me. And she went forth after him' (179, Promethean theft, keep); 'he opened the door... they were as conscious of all the evils they had ever sustained' (146, keep); Blodeuwedd coaxing Llew's death-manner (165, treachery not prohibition, reject)

rule: reject unless the child figures the unfallen/primordial state; Peredur is comic naivety awaiting knightly education, and infant Taliesin is an ancient sage in a child's body (puer senex, the inverse of innocence)
evidence: 'They are angels, my son... I will go and become an angel with them' (023, closest but comic-naive); 'Although I am but little, I am highly gifted' (180, wonder-child not innocence)

rule: reject unless a staged upward soul-journey through realms is traced; quest itineraries, dream-geography over mountains, 'summit of fame', and Taliesin's catalogue of celestial presences are not an ascent path
evidence: 'whoso would reach the summit of fame and of honour' (046, worldly); 'I was with my Lord in the highest sphere' (185, presence-catalogue not staged journey)

rule: reject unless exile is from divine origin/paradise; keep 190's Eden expulsion, reject romantic remorse, grief-death, and political disinheritance
evidence: 'Thence were they driven, Cold and shivering... Into this world' (190, keep); 'woe is me that I was ever born; two islands have been destroyed because of me' (145, grief not exile-from-source)

rule: keep where deprivation/prayer is undertaken as discipline to gain pardon or divine gift (seven years' penance 114, Moses fasting in Jordan 190, hunger 'for the Son of the Virgin' 186); reject incidental hunger and Enid's grief-fast protest
evidence: 'I remained doing penance seven years, and after that I gained pardon' (114, keep); 'I will not eat until the man that is upon yonder bier shall eat likewise' (078, fidelity protest, reject)

rule: reject unless irrational rapture is itself the vehicle of divine contact/higher knowledge; pregnancy wildness, lovesickness, and spirit-imposed dumbness of the bards (a curse of impotence, not rapture) all fail
evidence: 'Goleuddydd became wild, and wandered about... her reason came back to her' (083, obstetric not divine); 'not from the strength of drink... but through the influence of a spirit' (185, imposed folly on rivals, not the mad one's higher knowledge)

rule: keep if passage depicts or prescribes address/petition to a divine or spirit power (orison, invocation, pardon-prayer, formula); reject only where 'pray' is incidental narrative color
evidence: E008 'the duty of prayer—the daily recognition of the Unseen and Eternal... offers his unspoken orison'; M073 'there are certain prayers which the initiated say... the hunter humbly begs of him'

rule: keep if a deity is depicted as personally aware of and responsive to humans (hears, pities, hosts, answers, sets conditions); reject/reassign to anthropomorphism where the supernatural actor is just a myth character (giants, transformed animals, monster-fights) or sacred power is diffuse
evidence: E011 'allowed to live by the mysterious favor and interference of the Giver of Life' (keep); M024 'the great Apportioner (the Sun) took pity on him' (keep); M094 Thunder boiling his son in a pot is myth-adventure, not a doctrine of a responsive God (reject)

rule: keep if passage asserts the divine purposefully orders creation/events toward good ends (divine decree, 'made for a purpose', watching over a people); reject mythic aetiology ('that is why...') and one-off divine favors inside tale narrative
evidence: E019 'Warfare we regarded as an institution of the Great Mystery... all is known to the Great Mystery' (keep); M014 'Even weeds were made for some good purpose' (keep); M107 dream-visit of Selu granting hunting luck is a favor-tale, not pronoia (reject)

rule: keep if fasting/vigil functions as preparation for spiritual sight, power, transformation, or purification; reject only incidental hunger
evidence: E001 bambeday retreat 'purifying vapor-bath... naked, erect, silent... a night and a day' ; M127 'If you want to see us, fast four days... fast again seven days, and we will come and take you'

rule: keep where sun/moon/thunder/corn/nature powers are given human form, kin-relations, or emotions; M176 (cedar human-figure 'medicine' image) is the only marginal member
evidence: M019 'The Sun... had a human figure, but was too bright for them to see clearly'; E021 'his attribution of personality and will to the elements, the sun and stars'

rule: keep where generosity/hospitality/care for the weak is taught as a moral-spiritual duty or ideal (Eastman pattern); reject battle heroism and narrative assistance episodes without moral framing (Mooney pattern)
evidence: E018 'the child must early learn the beauty of generosity... give to the point of utter impoverishment... orphans and the aged are invariably cared for' (keep); M183 warrior's zigzag death-run to save companions is heroism, not neighbor-love doctrine (reject)

rule: keep where fire itself is sacred/honored or receives offerings (constant mound fire, new-fire rite, incense, morsel cast into fire); reject narrative fire — origin-of-fire tale, fire as weapon/trap/execution
evidence: M184 'atsi'la galunkw'ti'yu, the honored or sacred fire... burns yet at the bottom of these great mounds' (keep); M077 circle of burning pine cones dug as a trap for the Uktena (reject); E008 'casts it into the fire—the purest and most ethereal element' (keep)

rule: keep: hidden like-affects-like linkages (tabus, occult connections, omen/premonition, species alliances) are this cell's home move — it is also the correct landing zone for reassigns from correspondence/theurgy
evidence: M073 'the snakes, the deer, and the ginseng act as allies, so that an injury to one is avenged by all'; M216 laurel never burned because its hissing leaves 'suggest winter winds and falling snow' would bring cold

rule: keep only where things share nature/structure across levels (pine 'of the same nature as the stars', mirrored underworld, explicit 'theory of correspondences' in medicine); reassign like-affects-like tabus and occult-connection magic to cosmic_sympathy
evidence: M022 'the pine is of the same nature as the stars and holds in itself the same bright light' (keep); M214 'selected chiefly in accordance with the theory of correspondences' (keep); M028 rheumatism tabu via 'occult connection' with the buffalo's hump (reassign)

rule: keep where a guide conducts persons/souls into the ghost country or a spirit realm (Tsusgina'i retrieval, underground-people guide, mountain-people escort); reject unguided glimpses of the dead (whirlpool vision)
evidence: M015 'bring back her daughter from Tsusgina'i, the Ghost country, in the Darkening land' with seven guided emissaries (keep); M001 'one must fast and go to water and have one of the underground people for a guide' (keep); M133 drowning man merely sees the dead beckon (reject)

rule: keep where 4/7 function as sacred-structural pattern (explicitly called sacred/magic, or organizing cosmos, rite, or formula); reject only if a number is a bare narrative count
evidence: E014 'the number four is the magic or sacred number of the Indian'; M001 'the seventh height... seven hand-breadths above the earth'; M217 'Seven grains, the sacred number, were put into each hill'

rule: keep pacts between humans and spirit/divine beings with mutual obligations (Sun Dance vow, animal-tribe compacts, snake prayer-song pact, Tsul'kalu's fast-condition); reject human-nation diplomacy (Iroquois wampum peace embassies M141-142, M156-157) and treaty-bad-faith critique (E004)
evidence: M086 Black Rattlesnake: 'sing this song and we will not hurt you... and the Cherokee have kept the song to this day' (keep); M141 Iroquois wampum-belt peace mission is inter-tribal politics (reject)

rule: keep critiques of form-without-substance religion and exposures of sham piety (incl. the fake star-feather prophet M190); reject deceit tales with no religious dimension (M164 false war boasting)
evidence: E003 'the professionalism of the pulpit, the paid exhorter, the moneyed church, was an unspiritual and unedifying thing... its Phariseeism'; E004 'They spoke much of spiritual things, while seeking only the material'

rule: keep where the supreme divine/Great Mystery is beyond ordinary perception or deliberately unrepresented (incl. Tsul'kalu's 'now you can never see me'); reject invisible fairy settlements and hidden places (M104 lake, M127-128 mountain people)
evidence: E021 'the great Mysterious One is not brought directly upon the scene or conceived in anthropomorphic fashion, but remains sublimely in the background' (keep); M104 invisible medicine lake is a hidden place, not a hidden God (reject)

rule: keep only where a rite draws divine presence/power into matter or place (M217 corn-spirit invoked audibly into the field; E013 power projected via consecrated medicine bags; E014 vapor-bath revivifies bones); reassign consecrated-charm hunting magic (M029) to cosmic_sympathy and reject plain formula-prayers (M073)
evidence: M217 'sang songs of invocation to the spirit of the corn... a loud rustling would be heard... the Old Woman bringing the corn into the field' (keep); M029 consecrated Little Deer horn 'attracts the deer to the hunter' is charm-sympathy, not god-engagement (reassign)

rule: keep where names are tabooed, esoteric-priestly, protective-circumlocutory, or used in formulas because naming has power; reject bare etymology lists
evidence: E003 'His name was not spoken aloud, even with utmost reverence'; M020 'the priests call the Sun Su'talidihi... though nobody knows now what this word means'; M215 ginseng 'addressed in the formulas as Yunwi Usdi, Little Man'

rule: keep — all-Eastman cell, every chunk carries possessions-as-snare doctrine explicitly
evidence: E002 'his religion forbade the accumulation of wealth... the love of possessions has appeared a snare'; E018 'the love of possessions is a weakness to be overcome... give to the point of utter impoverishment'

rule: keep only if concealed teaching is framed as transformative sacred truth reserved for the worthy (E002 oracle revealed 'to a chosen few', E012 secret-order instruction, arguably M101 deathbed revelation of medicine songs); reject guild/trade secrecy (M055 eagle-killers' business secrets, M107 hunting secrets) and reassign M214 priestly plant-names to sacred_names
evidence: E002 'an old man, standing upon the brink of eternity, might reveal to a chosen few the oracle of his long-past youth' (keep); M055 'the few professionals guarded their secrets carefully from outsiders their business was a quite profitable one' (reject)

rule: keep the Sun-father/Earth-mother cosmogonic union (E002, E021); reject supernatural-spouse folktales (M124 Tsul'kalu's wife, M131 Thunder's sister) and sacralized human marriage (E006)
evidence: E021 'The Sun and the Earth, representing the male and female principles... she conceived and brought forth life' (keep); M131 warrior weds Thunder's sister in a cave — spirit-bride tale, not union of cosmic principles (reject)

rule: accept: Krishna as personally responsive deity is the Gita's core register (first-person divine speech, reciprocal devotion)
evidence: 'I serve men in the way in which they approach me' (04.001); 'I, without delay, come forward as their deliverer' (12.001)

rule: accept: pan(en)theist one-reality claims pervade the tagged chunks
evidence: 'all this is woven upon me, like numbers of pearls upon a thread' (07.001); 'sees the self abiding in all beings, and all beings in the self... holding that all is one' (06.002)

rule: accept: liberation framed as going to Krishna/Brahman the origin, never to return to rebirth
evidence: 'after attaining to me, there is no birth again' (08.001); 'that seat from which those that go there never return... that same primal being from whom the ancient course emanated' (15.001)

rule: accept: jnana-marga chunks make knowledge-with-experience itself salvific
evidence: 'you will cross over all trespasses by means of the boat of knowledge alone' (04.002); 'knowledge, accompanied by experience... apprehended directly... released from evil' (09.001)

rule: accept: explicit merging/assimilation language (Brahman-bhuta, entering Krishna's essence), not mere fellowship
evidence: 'becoming (one with) the Brahman, obtain the Brahmic bliss' (05.002); 'attains that tranquillity which culminates in final emancipation, and assimilation with me' (06.001)

rule: accept: dhyana-yoga instruction (seat, gaze, breath, one-pointed mind) is the home move here
evidence: 'fixing his mind exclusively on one point... looking at the tip of his own nose' (06.001); 'concentrates the life-breath between the brows... continuous meditation' (08.001)

rule: accept: Krishna as supervisor ordering cosmos and history toward ends (avatara doctrine, Kalpa cycles, 'be only the instrument')
evidence: 'I am born age after age, for the protection of the good... and the establishment of piety' (04.001); 'the lord... is seated in the region of the heart of all beings, turning round all beings (as though) mounted on a machine' (18.003)

rule: keep Deity-voice passages on possession-attachment as obstacle; re-examine chapter-1/early-2 lament chunks (01.002, 01.003, 02.001) where wealth-renunciation is Arjuna's delusion the text refutes
evidence: 'full of the pride and frenzy of wealth... fall down into impure hell' (16.001, solid); 'I do not wish for victory... nor sovereignty, nor pleasures' (01.002, Arjuna's rejected lament)

rule: accept: Krishna's maya-veiled unknowability is stated in nearly every tagged chunk
evidence: 'Surrounded by the delusion of my mystic power, I am not manifest to all... But me nobody knows' (07.002); 'Not the multitudes of gods, nor the great sages know my source' (10.001)

rule: accept: nirguna/avyakta negation strings (unperceived, unthinkable, neither existent nor non-existent) are genuine via negativa
evidence: 'the indescribable, indestructible, unperceived... unthinkable' (12.001); 'which cannot be said to be existent or non-existent... devoid of qualities' (13.001)

rule: accept: nirdvandva (freedom from the pairs of opposites) is an explicit, named mark of the perfected sage, matching the definition's completion frame
evidence: 'rise above those effects of the three qualities, and be free from the pairs of opposites' (02.003); 'free from the pairs (of opposites) called pleasure and pain, go undeluded to that imperishable seat' (15.001)

rule: accept: uncreated divine luminosity and light-theophany are explicit in every tagged chunk
evidence: 'the lustre of a thousand suns burst forth all at once' (11.001); 'It is the radiance even of the radiant (bodies); it is said (to be) beyond darkness' (13.001)

rule: reject: nishkama karma is vigorous duty-bound action with fruit-renunciation, not effortless non-striving (gold B-01); all 7 chunks already carry detachment_gelassenheit which is the correct home
evidence: 'do you perform prescribed action, for action is better than inaction' (03.001); 'Nature will constrain you... you will do involuntarily, tied down by your own duty' (18.003)

rule: accept: Arjuna's second-person praise/petition and prescribed devotional address are genuine prayer
evidence: 'Obeisance be to thee a thousand times... I ask pardon of you' (11.003); 'offer sacrifices and pray to me for a passage into heaven' (09.001)

rule: accept: mind-stilling to quiescence is explicit (citta-nirodha register), plus taciturnity as mental penance
evidence: 'the mind restrained by practice of abstraction, ceases to work... should think of nothing... become quiescent' (06.002); 'calmness of mind, mildness, taciturnity' (17.001)

rule: accept: divine light/lamp located within the person, perceivable by introspection; 03.002 is the one light-free borderline
evidence: 'whose light (of knowledge) also is within (himself)' (05.002); 'remaining in their hearts, I destroy, with the brilliant lamp of knowledge, the darkness' (10.001)

rule: accept: explicit hypocrite-critique and ostentation-without-substance passages in every chunk
evidence: 'restraining the organs of action, continues to think in his mind about objects of sense, is called a hypocrite' (03.001); 'sacrifices, which are sacrifices only in name, with ostentatiousness' (16.001)

rule: accept: unlike the rejected buddhism cell, these chunks assert an indwelling divine (Krishna/supreme self in the heart) found within oneself
evidence: 'The devotee whose happiness is within... becoming (one with) the Brahman' (05.002); 'I am the self... seated in the hearts of all beings' (10.001); 'perceive him abiding within their selfs' (15.001)

rule: accept: 'highest mystery' framing plus explicit restriction of the teaching to the worthy; 10.001 is the weakest (divine hiddenness rather than reserved teaching)
evidence: 'I have declared to you to-day... for it is the highest mystery' (04.001); 'This you should never declare to one who performs no penance, who is not a devotee' (18.004)

rule: accept: single first principle sourcing all multiplicity is expressed, though 'absolute simplicity' is thinner than the Greek home move
evidence: 'I am in every way the origin of the gods and great sages... beginning and the middle and the end of all beings' (10.001); 'I stand supporting all this by (but) a single portion (of myself)' (10.002)

rule: accept: divine embodiment is explicit (human avatara, visvarupa body imagery, Brahman with hands/eyes/faces)
evidence: 'disregard me as I have assumed a human body' (09.001); 'It has hands and feet on all sides, it has eyes, heads, and faces on all sides' (13.001)

rule: keep when a divine/celestial being (Life, Gnosis-of-Life, Sun, Earth, Sauriel, Ruha, the Treasury) speaks, weeps, embraces, or acts in embodied human fashion; reject the few chunks that are purely human drama (e.g. 2.005 mother's plea)
evidence: 'The Sun opened his mouth and spake unto Yahya' (1.005); 'I set up my throne and sat down, as a father who sits midst his sons' — Life's Gnosis (3.016)

rule: keep; Light-region theology is substantive in nearly every chunk, not just the opening doxology
evidence: 'The King from outside of the worlds set a crown of Light on his head' (3.014); 'Ever did I give light to the treasures and to the shekinahs' (3.012)

rule: keep when the Light-region/Darkness-region two-realm opposition or two-natures doctrine is on the page (it usually is); reject formula-only headers like 3.005
evidence: 'Two Kings were there, two natures were fashioned — a King of this world... and a King from outside of the worlds' (3.014); 'Water does not mix with pitch, and the Light is not reckoned as Darkness' (3.007). Mead notes they were 'not absolute Dualists' (Life transcends both), but the two-realm ontology is genuine and pervasive

rule: keep only if the chunk contains actual address/petition/praise to the divine or thematizes prayer practice (night-prayer, 'Miryai in humbleness prays'); reject chunks tagged solely on the section-opening doxology 'In the Name of Great Life may hallowed Light be glorified'
evidence: keep: 'Have compassion... and forgive us our sins' (3.009), 'I have not forgotten my night-prayer' (1.004); reject: 3.005 is a header-only chunk whose sole content is the doxology yet carries 4 concept tags — formula keying

rule: keep; the masiqta soul-ascent past guard-houses/tax-gatherers to Light's region is the concept's genuine home move here
evidence: 'They clear me and let me ascend... he who is not found sinless, will be called to account in the guard-houses' (1.004); 'raise them on high in my ship and guide them past all the tax-gatherers' (3.007)

rule: keep when the Name's ontological power is thematized (Name uttered over someone, naming the Name, name divinely bestowed); reject when the only basis is the bare section-opening 'In the Name of Great Life' formula (3.001, 3.005, 3.008, 3.012, 3.014, 2.003)
evidence: keep: 'Fire does not burn thee, O Yahya, for Life's Name has been uttered o'er thee' (1.008), 'on my Name they mount up and behold the Light's region' (3.013); reject: 3.005 formula-only header

rule: keep when the soul ascends to Light's region/Life's House as its origin-home; the Mandaean soul is explicitly sent from the Light-world, so ascent = return
evidence: soul pre-existed 'in the Bowl', Envoy 'from the House of my Father' frees Adam to ascend (3.015); 'I have come unto thee, O Soul, whom Life has sent into this world' (1.008)

rule: keep when salvation comes through instruction/awakening/revealed truth (the manda that names the religion); watch only for chunks where 'Life's Gnosis' is a bare proper name with no knowledge-soteriology
evidence: 'Whosoever lets himself be enlightened through me and instructed, ascends and beholds the Light's region' (3.013); Letter of Truth: 'he opened it and read in it and became full of life' (1.007)

rule: keep when Day-of-Judgment, End-Sea, or end-of-age verdict on the wicked collectively; reassign to psychopomp_journey when only the individual soul's post-mortem accounting at guard-stations (1.004, 1.010); reject mythic-historical retribution (eagle destroying Jerusalem, 2.006/3.008)
evidence: strong: 'what will you do on the Day of the Judgment... The Planets are like fatted oxen, who stand there for the Day of the Slaughter' (1.007), 'the wicked... sink into the great Sea of the Ending' (3.012); weak: 'he who is not found sinless, will be called to account in the guard-houses' (1.004) is individual passage

rule: keep for Jordan baptism, the pure sign, cleansing/washing, and the pure-vs-filth axis (including the fish-who-eat-no-filth allegory); this is core Mandaean masbuta material
evidence: 'We will be baptized with his baptizing and with his pure sign be signed' (1.003); 'I cleansed them and washed them and made them to smell the sweet odour of Life' (3.009)

rule: keep; the 'vain body' (pagria) and 'house of defect' formulas are exactly the concept
evidence: 'Firmly developed has the soul been brought into the vain body' (1.016); 'The house of defect will be left behind in the desert' (1.004); 'the soul, the pure mind, and into the vain body cast it' (3.015)

rule: keep when the soul's exile in this world is voiced with pathos (weeping, faded splendour, longing); reject when the passage is the savior's own descent (3.001) or communal displacement allegory with no exile-from-origin affect (2.003 borderline)
evidence: strong: 'Gnosis of Life who is far from the height... O Soul, whom Life has sent into this world... Wherefor do ye weep, generations, wherefor fadeth your splendour?' (1.008); weak: Fisher 'comes into this world of the fleeting' (3.001) is the envoy's mission, not exile

rule: keep when gold/silver/possessions are forsaken or subordinated to alms and the Life; 1.006 (communal mourning stripping jewels at John's voice) is the one stretch
evidence: 'Whoever of me, Life's Treasury, makes his investment, loves not gold and silver, loves not gold and possessions' (3.013); 'Instead of buying a brick grave for dear gold, go rather and share out for me bread' (1.013)

rule: reject unless the VERSE itself stages an upward passage through realms/levels (v.218 'urdhvamsrotas, carried upwards'; v.224 'by these three steps thou wilt go near the gods'); crossing-to-the-other-shore and path-to-Nirvana language is not ascent, and 'ascending scale of worlds' grounded only in Muller footnotes does not count
evidence: 'he is called urdhvamsrotas (carried upwards by the stream)' [dhammapada-chapter-16.001, keep]; 'Few arrive at the other shore; the other people run up and down the shore' [dhammapada-chapter-06.002, crossing not ascent]

rule: reject: Nirvana as extinction/cessation is not a soul returning to divine origin (anatta — same ground as gold-set B-09 kingdom_within rejection); no Dhammapada/sutra chunk posits a source to return to
evidence: 'the mind... has attained to the extinction of all desires' [dhammapada-chapter-11.003]; 'when the envelopment of consciousness has been annihilated... enjoying final Nirvana' [heart-sutra-smaller.001, already carries sunyata_emptiness among 16 blanket tags]

rule: keep only where the verse disparages the body itself as foul/pain/hindrance (vv.146-150 'dressed-up lump... heap of corruption', vv.202-203 'no pain like this body'); reject lust-as-bondage verses, emptiness-of-form (heart sutra), 'last body' end-of-rebirth phrasing, and footnote-only chunks (chapter-01.005 is 100% Muller apparatus)
evidence: 'Look at this dressed-up lump, covered with wounds... heap of corruption' [dhammapada-chapter-11.001, keep]; 'form here is emptiness' [heart-sutra-smaller.001, reject — emptiness not obstacle]

rule: keep where the verse enjoins reviewing/watching one's own conduct (v.50 own misdeeds not others', vv.157-159 watch himself, vv.379-380 'examine thyself by thyself'); reject generic mind-precedes-action verses (vv.1-2), moral-discernment verses, and footnote-only chunks (chapter-01.005)
evidence: 'Rouse thyself by thyself, examine thyself by thyself' [dhammapada-chapter-25.002, keep]; 'All that we are is the result of what we have thought' [dhammapada-chapter-01.001, reject — different move]

rule: reject: 'full of light', 'shines forth by his knowledge', 'bright like the moon' are wisdom-brightness similes, not an indwelling divine spark — anatta forecloses the concept's home move (same logic as kingdom_within B-09)
evidence: 'whose appetites have been conquered, and who are full of light' [dhammapada-chapter-06.002]; 'the disciple of Buddha shines forth by his knowledge' [dhammapada-chapter-01.003]

rule: reject: mentions of Yama, death carrying men off, and hell destinations are mortality/karma teaching, not a text or ritual guiding the soul through death realms — likely lexical keying on Yama/death
evidence: 'the world of Yama (the lord of the departed)' [dhammapada-chapter-04.001]; 'Death carries off a man who is gathering flowers' [dhammapada-chapter-20.002]

rule: reject: karmic ripening and individual heaven/hell destinations are continuous personal retribution, not a final collective cosmic judgment with verdict and restoration — no judge, no end-event in any sampled verse
evidence: 'when his evil deed has ripened, then does the evil-doer see evil... evil-doers go to hell; righteous people go to heaven' [dhammapada-chapter-09.001]; 'when his body is destroyed, the fool will go to hell' [dhammapada-chapter-10.002]

rule: reject: becoming Brahmana/arhat/Buddha is self-effort awakening with no theos, no grace, no partaking of divine nature — the false friend predicted by calibration held; nearest miss is v.418-423 conqueror-of-worlds language, still not deification
evidence: 'wise people fashion themselves' [dhammapada-chapter-06.001]; 'the hero who has conquered all the worlds... awakened (Buddha)' [dhammapada-chapter-26.004, transformation but no divine nature by grace]

rule: reject: brightness is simile for wisdom or the awakened one ('bright like the moon', Buddha 'bright with splendour'), never an uncreated luminous quality of the divine experienced mystically — the metaphorical 'light of wisdom' case flagged in calibration
evidence: 'the Brahmana is bright in his meditation; but Buddha... is bright with splendour day and night' [dhammapada-chapter-26.001]; 'We shall be like the bright gods, feeding on happiness!' [dhammapada-chapter-15.001, contentment simile]

rule: keep where light/sun/shining IS the divine or the vision of true being (sun as child of the Good, beatific vision 'shining in pure light', 'clear light... light of truth'); reject dialectic-method, rhetoric, and astronomy chunks where brightness is physical or absent
evidence: 'we beheld the beatific vision... shining in pure light' [plato-phaedrus.017, keep]; 'in the garden of letters he will sow and plant' [plato-phaedrus.036, reject — no light at all]

rule: keep wherever rebirth/transmigration across bodies or species is asserted (born from the dead, soul wears many bodies, passing into animals/women); reject soul-immortality or purification arguments that never mention re-embodiment (phaedo.009, .016)
evidence: 'the living come from the dead... how could they be born again?' [plato-phaedo.010]; 'These are the laws by which animals pass into one another... as they lose or gain wisdom' [plato-timaeus.050]

rule: reject: Plato's rare philosophers are made by education/circumstance, can rise or fall across lives, and are ordered back down to the many — not a fixed pneumatic/psychic/hylic anthropology with predestined salvation; the 'few mystics' and 'small remnant' passages are the nearest misses but the move is attainment, not elect nature
evidence: 'the worthy disciples of philosophy will be but a small remnant' [plato-republic-6-1.007, nearest miss]; 'they must be made to descend again among the prisoners in the den, and partake of their labours' [plato-republic-7-0.004, anti-elect]

rule: keep where a descending chain of divine principles is staged (the Good begets the sun as its child, beyond essence; demiurge delegates mortal-making to younger gods each less perfect); reject world-soul mechanics, receptacle/triangle cosmology, and god-procession pageantry without levels flowing from a source
evidence: 'the child of the good, whom the good begat in his own likeness... the good is not essence, but far exceeds essence' [plato-republic-6-2.002, keep]; 'he committed to the younger gods the fashioning of their mortal bodies' [plato-timaeus.016, keep]

rule: keep where ordinary humanity is depicted as asleep/dreaming/chained in illusion and the path begins by recognising it (cave prisoners 'like ourselves'; 'dreaming and slumbering in this life, before he is well awake'); reject rhetoric, misology, and physiology chunks
evidence: 'they have been from their childhood... chained... they see only their own shadows. Like ourselves, I replied' [plato-republic-7-0.001, keep]; 'dreaming and slumbering in this life, before he is well awake here, he arrives at the world below' [plato-republic-7-0.014, keep]

rule: keep the Phaedo afterlife-geography chunks where the dead soul's route, waypoints, and guides are mapped (many partings of the road, Acheron/Styx/Tartarus, conveyance to the lake) — valid cross-tradition mapping per review guidance; reject deathbed-scene and purification-doctrine chunks (bath, burial talk, cock to Asclepius) that guide no soul anywhere
evidence: 'this journey to the other world is not... a single and straight path... there are many partings of the road, and windings' [plato-phaedo.036, keep]; 'Crito, I owe a cock to Asclepius' [plato-phaedo.044, reject — death scene, not navigation]

rule: keep where a genius/appointed guide conducts the dead soul (Phaedo 107d-108c, 113d); reject deathbed scenes, swan-song passages, and judgment-lottery chunks where souls travel unguided
evidence: 'the genius of each individual... leads him to a certain place... following the guide who is appointed to conduct them' [plato-phaedo.036, keep]; 'burying my body only' [plato-phaedo.042, reject]

rule: keep where divine reason/mind or the world-soul is the cosmos-ordering or mediating principle ('Mind, the ruling power, persuaded necessity'; world-soul compounded as 'intermediate kind of essence' between indivisible and divisible); reject anatomy chunks where 'designed by mind' is a passing phrase (timaeus.037, .039)
evidence: 'Mind, the ruling power, persuaded necessity to bring the greater part of created things to perfection' [plato-timaeus.019, keep]; 'Thus the hair sprang up in the skin' [plato-timaeus.039, reject]

rule: reject unless the passage treats absolute unity/the One as an intelligible first principle drawing the mind to true being (republic-7-0.007 is the lone borderline keep); 'one and one make two' puzzles, indivisible arithmetic units, and 'one only begotten heaven' are lexical keying on 'one', not the simple source of all multiplicity
evidence: 'the soul... asks What is absolute unity? ... the study of the one has a power of... converting the mind to the contemplation of true being' [plato-republic-7-0.007, borderline]; 'the mere juxtaposition of them can be the cause of their becoming two' [plato-phaedo.029, reject — arithmetic puzzle]

rule: reject unless the passage presents a deity as personally responsive to petition or worship; gods as myth-plot actors or bare name mentions (plus Bellows' editorial notes) do not qualify
evidence: hovamol.004 'Better a house, though a hut it be' (godless gnomic counsel); voluspo.005 is dwarf name-catalogue; voluspo.002 Volva speaks 'unwillingly, being compelled' by Othin's magic — coercion, not responsive relation

rule: keep where gods act embodied with human form/emotion (Othin's spear, eye, love affairs, hanging; Thor's rage; Baldr bleeding); reject gnomic-counsel and pure name-catalogue chunks with no divine actor
evidence: voluspo.007 'On the host his spear did Othin hurl... In swelling rage then rose up Thor'; hovamol.002 guest etiquette, no deity present

rule: keep where runes/charms/redes are esoteric knowledge transmitted or explicitly withheld (Hovamol rune-winning, Ljothatal, Loddfafnismol); reject Voluspo narrative where 'secrets' are just the seeress's plot revelations, and plain gnomic wisdom
evidence: hovamol.016 'An eighteenth I know, that ne'er will I tell to maiden or wife of man' (real esoteric reserve); voluspo.007 'I know of the horn of Heimdall, hidden' (mythic secret, not teaching)

rule: reject unless two primal ontological principles structure reality; gods-vs-giants/Wanes conflict, Ragnarok battle, and dwarf catalogues are mythic opposition, not dualism
evidence: voluspo.004-005 are the interpolated dwarf name-list ('Nyi and Nithi, Northri and Suthri...'); hovamol.012 is Loddfafnir etiquette redes with no cosmology at all

rule: keep where runes/charms function as power-formulas in magical practice (Hovamol 137-165 rune and charm stanzas, Voluspo st.60 'ancient runes of the Ruler of Gods'); reject name-catalogues (dwarfs, Valkyries) and translator's etymology glosses
evidence: hovamol.014 'Knowest how one shall write, knowest how one shall rede? Knowest how one shall tint...' (rune formulas, keep); voluspo.009 Valkyrie list 'Skuld bore the shield, and Skogul rode next' (catalogue, reject)

rule: reject unless the passage morally sorts wicked/righteous to their deserts (Nastrond's oath-breakers tortured, Gimle's righteous rewarded); Ragnarok battle/destruction/renewal alone is doom, not a judgment with verdict
evidence: voluspo.015 'The sun turns black, earth sinks in the sea' (destruction, no assize); marginal keeps: voluspo.011 Nastrond where 'the wicked undergo tortures', voluspo.016 'There shall the righteous rulers dwell'

rule: reject: Norse orlog/Norn-fate is impersonal necessity that binds even the gods (Othin foreknows his own doom) — the inverse of pronoia; no fate-concept exists in taxonomy to reassign to
evidence: voluspo.006 Norns 'Laws they made there, and life allotted... and set their fates'; hovamol.005 'Let no man the fate before him see, for so is he freest from sorrow'

rule: keep only where contradiction/reversal is itself the teaching device (Othin 'offered I was... myself to myself'); reject straightforward prudential maxims even when counterintuitive
evidence: hovamol.013 'offered I was to Othin, myself to myself' (genuine paradox, keep); hovamol.003 'Shun not the mead, but drink in measure' (plain counsel)

rule: reject: Hovamol critiques false FRIENDSHIP and social deceit, not outward religious observance lacking inner transformation — classic false-friend stretch
evidence: hovamol.005 'Hotter than fire between false friends does friendship five days burn'; hovamol.008 'When fairest we speak, then falsest we think' (deceit in wooing)

rule: keep only where a being conducts souls to an afterlife realm (Valkyries bringing the slain to Valhall; possibly souls on Hel-roads); reject afterlife topography and Ragnarok battle scenes
evidence: voluspo.009 Valkyries 'Choosers of the Slain... bring the bravest warriors killed in battle to Valhall' (keep); voluspo.011 Nastrond geography 'the land of the dead, ruled by the goddess Hel' (no guided passage)

rule: reject formulaic sacred numbers (three Norns, thrice-burned, nine nights) — folkloric motif, not number as ontological principle; the one defensible keep is voluspo.002's nine-worlds cosmic structure
evidence: voluspo.002 'Nine worlds I knew, the nine in the tree' (marginal keep); voluspo.006 'Three times burned, and three times born' (formulaic motif)

rule: reject prudential/social silence (guest etiquette, guarding one's tongue); keep only silence as receptivity to divine speech — hovamol.010 is the sole such case
evidence: hovamol.002 'The knowing guest... in silent attention sits' (prudence, not contemplation); hovamol.010 'I saw and was silent... and heard the speech of Hor' (genuine receptive silence, keep)

rule: keep only transgressive/illicit acquisition (Othin's Promethean theft of the mead of poetry; arguably Gollveig-Heith's corrupting witchcraft); reject costly-sacrifice knowledge (Othin's eye) and prudential ignorance of fate
evidence: hovamol.009 Othin as Bolverk steals the mead: 'Suttung's betrayal he sought with drink, and Gunnloth to grief he left' (keep); voluspo.008 'Othin's sacrifice of his eye in order to gain knowledge' (paid-for, not forbidden)

rule: keep: theurgic/Chaldean divine fire as medium of divine presence is the explicit home move throughout Iamblichus; reject only if a chunk mentions no fire/light-descent at all (e.g. pure sacrificial-taxonomy passages)
evidence: iamb.051 'a species of fire is seen by the recipient... who receives a divine fire'; iamb.081 'an ascent will be afforded to theurgists to intelligible fire... the end of every theurgic operation'; iamb.208 Chaldean oracle: telestic art 'obliterates through divine fire all the stains of generation'

rule: reject unless divine receptivity is figured as drunkenness/wine (absent in all sampled chunks); where the passage analyzes enthousiasmos/Bacchic possession and divine_madness is not already co-tagged (e.g. iamb.171), reassign to divine_madness instead
evidence: iamb.055 'the power of Sabazius appropriately pertains to Bacchic inspiration' (possession-mania, already co-tagged divine_madness); iamb.190 Pythagorean music therapy, no intoxication figure at all

rule: reject: lexical keying on 'Boundless/Uncontainable' epithets of the Ineffable and its emanations — Pistis Sophia's cosmos is an elaborately bounded hierarchy of veils, gates, and ordered Spaces, the opposite of Bruno's centerless infinite universe of innumerable worlds
evidence: ps.087 'Boundless Uncontainable ones... arrays of the Space of the Ineffable' (divine transcendence epithets, not cosmology); ps.009 ascent through numbered 'twelve Aeons' with 'veils and gates' (structured, bounded cosmos)

rule: reject: power-names, vowel-strings, and seals are already covered by co-tags (sacred_names, permutation_of_letters on these chunks); no 22-Hebrew-letters-as-building-blocks doctrine; borderline sole keep is ps.145's cosmogonic vowel exegesis
evidence: ps.145 'i o t a, The Universe came out alpha... o, Will become the completion of all the completions' (closest match, and already co-tagged sacred_names); ps.139-140 are archon embryology with seals, no letters at all

rule: keep where the Hebrew letters are explicitly cosmogonic (Agrippa ch.74's Sefer Yetzirah division of 3 mothers/7 double/12 simple, 'to explain all things, how they proceed from the first cause'); reject ch.33's astral seals/characters stamped on natural things (that is correspondence/signatures) and Paracelsus's generic praise of cabala
evidence: agrippa-ch-74.001 'three mothers, seven double... signify the Twelve Signs, Seven Planets, and Three Elements' (strong keep); agrippa-ch-33.001 'every natural thing receives... some particular Seal... stamped upon it by its star' (signatures, not letters)

rule: keep if Hebrew letters are treated as cosmic principles/agents of creation (Sepher Yetzirah exposition, Tetragram cosmogony, letters=numbers=principles); reject only if letters appear solely as Tarot card labels with no creative-cosmic framing
evidence: sta.283 'Heaven was created from the elementary fire ש... the three Mothers אמש produce in the year heat, coldness'; tmd.020 'By adding to this JOD the triadic name of Eve, the name of Jehova is formed'

rule: keep if the passage expounds the sephirotic scheme (names plus structure/meaning, e.g. ten-emanation lists, Tree/pillars, four worlds); reject where sephirot names serve only as invocation words or a passing correspondence
evidence: KEEP tmd.051 'KETHER — The Crown, the equilibrating power... CHOKMAH... BINAH' (full decad exposition), sta.290 Ain Soph/Kether/four worlds; REJECT tmr.024 'by the Three Names which are Netsah, Hod, and Jesod' (liturgical name-use only), tmd.031 Macroprosopus in an element-correspondence list

rule: keep if power/meaning is derived by combining, reversing, inserting, or rearranging letters/names (ROTA/TARO, ABRACADABRA triangle, Shemhamphoras, Shin-into-YHVH); reject bare Tarot-history or alphabet catalogs without manipulation
evidence: tmr.020 'The magic triangle... ABRACADABRA... The initial A is repeated five and reproduced thirty times'; sta.305 'by inserting the letter ש in the middle of the name Jehovah, the word Jehoshua, or Jesus, is formed'

rule: keep if fire functions as consecrated ritual medium or object of cultus (altar/sacred fire, vestal flame, pyrolatry, evocation fires); reject metaphorical fire (Lucifer 'regenerates by fire', comets) and incidental scriptural flame imagery
evidence: KEEP sta.097 'Isis... carries with her the sacred fire, religiously preserved and kept burning in a special temple by the vestal virgins', sta.237 pyrolatry supplanting stone worship; REJECT tmr.002 'he is the angel who... regenerates by fire' (Lucifer metaphor)

rule: keep only if the passage discusses texts/rites performed for the dead soul's passage (Book of the Dead, heart scarabs, opening of the mouth, initiatory death-journey mapped to funerary rite); reject living-hero underworld-descent retellings (Xibalba chunks, already co-tagged shamanic_journey) and general post-mortem doctrine
evidence: KEEP sta.207 'thou shalt make a scarab of green stone... it shall perform for him the opening of the mouth'; REJECT sta.503-508 Popol Vuh trials ('the actual ordeals of the Xibalbian Mysteries were seven in number' — living initiates, not a dead soul guided), tmd.081 post-mortem star-attraction doctrine (soul_migration already co-tagged)

rule: reject unless the passage itself frames beings as governors of the lower/material world obstructing souls; Maya death-lords in narrative and Levi's impersonal astral-light serpent are not archons
evidence: sta.504 'twelve assembled princes' are underworld ordeal-givers, not planetary rulers; only sta.508 gestures at the move ('the princes of Xibalba are the twelve Governors of the lower universe') — the one arguable keep; tmd.081 'the unpurified Astral Light which envelops and imprisons' is impersonal, no rulers

rule: keep if letters are used as objects of contemplation or cosmic symbols worked in practice (star-contemplation yielding letter-visions, Tarot-as-letter oracle); weakest case is pure card-catalog continuation with no contemplative frame (tmr.113)
evidence: tmr.085 'a Kabalist... recognizes in the same sign the Ten SEPHIROTH... a well-formed GHIMEL placed above JOD, in a large DALETH... A long contemplation of the sky exalts imagination'; tmr.114 the letter-keyed Tarot as 'a truly philosophical machine' for acquiring universal knowledge

rule: reject unless the passage expounds truth/order as the Zoroastrian-style structural principle of the cosmos; Levi's rationalist 'Absolute Reason' doctrine and lexical hits on 'truth' or 'Zoroaster' do not qualify (real content already co-tagged logos, gnosis, apocatastasis)
evidence: tmd.088 'the Absolute is... the immutable law of reason and truth' (Hermetic rationalism, not asha); tmr.050 'no more wanting to the children of Zoroaster than to the faithful sheep of St. Peter' (name-drop only)

rule: keep only where the Ormuzd/Ahriman dualist doctrine is itself expounded or structurally applied (sta.033, sta.113); reject devil-name lists and Ormuz name-drops (tmr.030, tmr.069, tmr.117)
evidence: KEEP sta.033 'Ahriman became the Spirit of Evil... incarnate in the lower nature of man', sta.113 six malevolent signs 'symbolic of the 6,000 years of misery... caused by... Ahriman'; REJECT tmr.069 'the Ahriman of the Persians, the Typhon of the Egyptians' (list of devil-names in Baphomet exposition)

rule: keep where Æon/emanation doctrine is expounded (syzygies, 365 aeons, Pleroma, kabbalistic-world/aeon equations); the weak case is general Gnostic history with no aeon content (sta.036)
evidence: sta.037 'three pairs of opposites, called Syzygies... Mind (Nous) and Thought (Epinoia)... pleroma... produced out of the blending of the spiritual and material æons'; tmd.027 'the supreme circle was named ATZILUTH, and by the Gnostics PLEROMA' equating kabbalistic worlds with aeon-circles
